g.title: j192486309
g.text: Hey Lettie, how'd you get into being a medic?

g.title: j2343262249
g.text: Hey, Lettie, what brought you to Höllvania?

g.title: j2679444306
g.text: I didn't really have a choice.

g.title: j1791447004
g.text: I'm clearly bugging you, I'll leave you alone.

g.title: j4012166266
g.text: Then we have that in common
And you shouldn't ask stupid questions, babas

g.title: j351135093
g.text: It's not like I'm busy or anything

g.title: j3903191086
g.text: What should I talk to you about instead?

g.title: j295059931
g.text: Just trying to be friendly, sorry.

g.title: j2060895234
g.text: Didn't get much sleep last night
So I don't have much patience for bad questions

g.title: j2869357793
g.text: Didn't get much sleep last night

g.title: j2202650442
g.text: They *were* bad questions, though. lol. I just don't know what else to talk about

g.title: j1834462112
g.text: If you're gonna interrupt my day

g.title: j1891906263
g.text: Or are you just killing time

g.title: j2560386815
g.text: You did better with the question about the rats

g.title: j1784566480
g.text: Just trying to say hello, is all.

g.title: j2154145261
g.text: I just wanted to see how you were doing.

g.title: j2197686319
g.text: Make it interesting. Roger. I'll... go... think up... interesting things...

g.title: j2148123547
g.text: You did better with the question about home

g.title: j1499644420
g.text: Going to get back to it

g.title: j2863655817
g.text: Convince the locals to stop getting in between Techrot and scaldra
